name: Ivar the Foul
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
narrative.objectives: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, thank you. You have my gratitude, adventurer.

And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you killed Ivar the Foul? If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 11 to 12, 1,995 XP in all.

quests.name: Lost Deathstalkers
quests.objectiveText: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

quests.name: Wild Hearts
quests.objectiveText: Gather 3 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Return to Quinn
quests.objectiveText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Ivar the Foul
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
